info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Client Activities API

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: Specifies an entity id to start retrieving entries from. This is normally only used in generated nextlinks.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of entries to return from the beginning of the collection

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description:
account group key for accounts used in retrieving the trade data.
             If specified, activities of the specified account will be returned/published otherwise activities of all accounts represented by ClientKey.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description:
Unique key identifying the account used in retrieving the trade data.
             If specified, activities of the specified account will be returned/published otherwise activities of all accounts represented by ClientKey.

params.name: Activities
params.description: Specification of activity typese to return in results.

params.name: CANotificationTypes
params.description: Corporate action notification type to get the response for.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description:
Unique key identifying the client.
            If specified, activities of the specified client will be returned/published otherwise for logged in client.

params.name: Duration
params.description: The order duration type.

params.name: ExpirationDateTime
params.description: The expiration date should only be set if the duration type is GoodTillDate.

params.name: FieldGroups
params.description: Specification of field groups to return in results.

params.name: FromDateTime
params.description: If specified, activities starting FromDateTime will be returned/published. Default returns current day activities

params.name: IncludeSubAccounts
params.description: If specified true, activities of sub-clients will also be returned/published.

params.name: OrderStatuses
params.description: List of order statuses.

params.name: OrderTypes
params.description: List of order types.

params.name: PositionEventFilter
params.description: Specify position event filter if any. Default is PositionEventFilter.All.

params.name: SequenceId
params.description:
If specified and message with SequenceId available in ENS cache, streaming of events start from SequenceId.
            If sequenceId not found in ENS system, Subscription Error with "Sequence id unavailable"
            If not specified and FromDateTime is not specified, subscription will be real-time subscription.

params.name: TimeOnMargin
params.description:
Time the client has been on margin.
            If specified, margin activities with greater or equal to the time specified otherwise all activities.

params.name: ToDateTime
params.description: If specified, activities ending ToDateTime will be returned/published.

items.docs: Returns a list of activities specified by the parameters in the request.

params.name: ContextId
params.description: The context id part of the streaming session (used to identify the subscription within a streaming session).

params.name: Tag
params.description: Optional. Remove only subscriptions that are marked with specified tag.

items.docs: Removes multiple all subscriptions for the current session on this resource, and frees all resources on the server.

params.name: ContextId
params.description: Unique streaming context ID part of the streaming session.

params.name: ReferenceId
params.description: Unique ID of the subscription

items.docs: Removes subscription for the current session identified by subscription id.

info.name: Create a subscription for client events

items.docs: Sets up an active subscription to listen client events.
